# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of `solariskit` and `@akshatmittal/polycons` gets security fixes.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately through [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/akshatmittal/solaris/security/advisories/new).

Include the affected package and version, the steps to reproduce, and the impact.
